verdict.rationale: Synthesia has a documented public REST API (Video, Upload, Billing and Localization APIs, plus webhooks), so a downloadable machine-readable spec is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence shows an OpenAPI or equivalent spec file being offered for download. The docs llms.txt probe is an LLM-oriented documentation index, not an API specification, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.
